text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I... I can't believe it... I won the Derby...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Could you pinch my cheeks just to make

absolutely certain?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. All of our fans are watching
right now.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But seriously, how did you make it
happen? I
wasn't in any condition to win.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You just worked hard? That was enough
to help
me win?
choice_data_list: I just did the best I could.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You know, you might be even more
incredible
than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You've gone well beyond being a mere
"good
trainer" today.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: No, that's not at all fitting right now.
choice_data_list: Does that mean I'm not a good girl?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Can I praise you with the best
compliment I can
muster up?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Here I go! All the fans out there
watching,
say it with me! Ready? One,
two, three...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Who's a good little prodigy?! You are,
Trainer!
Yes, you are! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The chorus of praise echoes throughout
the
stands, symbolizing the gravity of
our
achievement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on your miraculous
Derby win,
Super Creek!
